support_claim: CRM row OAK-77 records the name Oakfield Logistics, commercial notes describe a rebrand between Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH with unchanged HRB 88421, and billing uses Oakfield Logistik GmbH, but no observation directly links crm:OAK-77 to billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of sameness and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; the packet documents a rebrand and parallel CRM and billing names but never ties the CRM identifier OAK-77 to the billing referent, so neither positive nor negative burden is met.
